system.description:
[Trigger: Initiative] You choose one from [Fire], [Cold], [Electricity], and [Evil Poison]. You gain [Reduction (selected tag): 100]. This [reduction] is canceled once the effect is activated. Scenario can be used once.

A shield featuring the death mask of a terrifying monster. From there, it can emit a final cry and deploy a powerful force field that nearly nullifies certain attacks.

Sturdy Fin [Core Material] (100G) + Wooden Round (100G) + [Magic Catalyst 6] (50G) x 5 + Crafting Cost (170G)
